adapter_hint: 2022 census volumes 2 and 4 by velayat (age, sex, nationality, mother tongue): python -m scripts.fetch_census.turkmenistan_census
population_note: The polygon drawn as Ahal holds Ashgabat city and Ahal velayat, which the census counts apart (Ashgabat is a city with the status of a velayat); it carries their sum.
sex_ratio_note: Men per 100 women, from the census's counts. The polygon drawn as Ahal holds Ashgabat city and Ahal velayat, which the census counts apart (Ashgabat is a city with the status of a velayat); it carries their sum.
median_age_note: Median interpolated within the age group holding the middle person (under 1, 1-4, then five-year groups to 85 and older); the census publishes no single years by velayat. The polygon drawn as Ahal holds Ashgabat city and Ahal velayat, which the census counts apart (Ashgabat is a city with the status of a velayat); it carries their sum.
ethnicity_note: Nationality (milli degişliligi) as each person declared it: the fifteen most numerous in the country, the rest as other nationalities (tables 4.3-4.8). The polygon drawn as Ahal holds Ashgabat city and Ahal velayat, which the census counts apart (Ashgabat is a city with the status of a velayat); it carries their sum.
language_note: Mother tongue, as each person named it: the nine languages the census tabulates, the rest as other languages (tables 4.12-4.29, first row). The polygon drawn as Ahal holds Ashgabat city and Ahal velayat, which the census counts apart (Ashgabat is a city with the status of a velayat); it carries their sum.
